title: Mayer-Vietoris exact sequence in right derived evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with two opens U,V covering X, and let E_W^n be the nth right derived functor of evaluation of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on the object W of X_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], for W in {X,U,V,U intersection V}. There are natural transformations delta_n : E_(U intersection V)^n → E_X^(n+1). For every coefficient sheaf F, the simultaneous restriction E_X^0(F) → E_U^0(F) × E_V^0(F) is injective. For each n the sequence E_X^n(F) → E_U^n(F) × E_V^n(F) → E_(U intersection V)^n(F) → E_X^(n+1)(F) → E_U^(n+1)(F) × E_V^(n+1)(F) is exact at the three interior positions; the second map is the difference of the restrictions. This asserts neither comparison with global sections on open schemes nor the vanishing consequence.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0A50 (lemma-mayer-vietoris), with Cohomology on Sites Lemma Tag 03F3 (sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-cohomology-of-open) for the identification $H^q_{\Et}(W,F)=H^q(W_{\Et},F|_W)$

proof.text: Use etale_mayerVietoris_sections to prove injectivity and exactness of the raw section sequence for every abelian coefficient sheaf. This uses the covering condition and the intersection pullback.

The inclusion U∩V→U is a monomorphism, reflected from its underlying scheme open immersion by the faithful forgetful functor. For an injective I, apply injective_sheaf_mono_restriction to lift a section y on U∩V to x on U. The pair (x,0) maps to y under the difference of restrictions, using map_zero and sub_zero. Thus the section sequence is short exact on injective objects.

Apply rightDerived_pair_sequence to the four evaluation functors at X,U,V,U∩V, and the four restriction transformations. Discharge its three hypotheses using the two previous steps. This supplies natural connecting transformations and the three interior exactness assertions.

The evaluation functors preserve finite limits, so their canonical degree-zero augmentations are isomorphisms. Given two degree-zero derived sections with identical derived restrictions, choose their preimages under the X augmentation. rightDerived_zero_transformation for the U,V restrictions, and injectivity of the U,V augmentations, show their raw restrictions agree. The proved raw section injection identifies the preimages; apply the X augmentation. Combine this injection with the transformations and exactness supplied above.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A50, first proof via Tag 093X and passage to injective resolutions
proof_origin.note: F2 proves the geometric section input and the initial derived injection; the general functor-level long exact sequence remains as one strict intermediate theorem.

mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact statement: the site Mayer-Vietoris theorem is for Ext-based H-prime, not right derived evaluation or its comparison with total derived global sections. Graded, Zariski and pro-etale results in the upstream source have different hypotheses and functors.
